correctness.rationale: The all-integer-q support formulas are verified directly from the exact bipartite successor-contact rule. Strict support-cardinality descent gives the sharp first periodic-entry time; injective periodic color-class maps give least period q for even q and q+1 for odd q. The 2 or 2q unique alternating palettes and onto-label counts prove the orbit formula. Exact occupancy inclusion-exclusion yields the conditional bound and its exponential rate. Embedded independent vertex-level tests (4692 experiments), symbolic support checks (2046), and exhaustive enumeration (145231 labelled initial states) corroborate but are not the infinite proof. Limits: arbitrary q analytical proof, q fixed in probability asymptotic, no claim of all possible periodic orbits.

value.rationale: The single missing color is the dominant large-n exception to the fully populated recurrent q-color phase, not an arbitrarily chosen slice. The exact all-q parity law changes the rare defect outcome from a q-period to a longer q+1-period precisely for odd alphabet size; it also fixes the earliest possible entry time and counts its labelled recurrent orbits throughout an infinite graph family. The conditional concentration quantifies the mathematically natural coupon-occupancy boundary and supplies a computable finite-n lower bound, extending beyond prior fixed-alphabet catalogs.
